verdict.rationale: Flagsmith has a public pricing page (flagsmith.com/pricing). The evidence from it only lists plan features such as SAML/SSO and 2FA, and states that feature flags and environments are unlimited, so those are not cost drivers. Nothing in the pack shows actual price points or which metrics drive cost. missing for 10: published price figures per plan, explicit cost drivers (seats, MAUs, API requests, events), overage/usage pricing details, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can see published pricing and understand what drives cost (seats, MAUs, events, requests) before committing
